company_summary: AI21 Labs is an Israeli company that specializes in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and develops AI systems that can understand and generate natural language. Their core products include generative AI models, such as the Jurassic and Jamba model families, and tools like Wordtune, a writing assistant. As of recent news, the company has raised a total of $336 million in funding and has a team size of approximately 200-265 employees. AI21 Labs focuses on building enterprise-grade AI systems and foundation models, positioning itself as a key player in the development of reliable and scalable AI solutions for businesses.
